trademaster.settings.huntCheaper.comment: After a successful lock the enchantment stays live: its price is marked and rerolling continues until a strictly cheaper copy is locked and the mark updated. The configured max price CAPS the hunt (lowering it mid-run applies at once, raising it never loosens the hunt). The mark only moves downwards: it records the price actually paid plus the other qualifying books' offered prices on the same villager. Mutually exclusive with auto-disable after lock, and auto-disable wins: enabling hunt while auto-disable is on is refused (a chat message says so; turn auto-disable off first), while enabling auto-disable silently turns hunt off. While hunt is on, the named-villager deduction is cancelled automatically (named villagers never block the hunt) and restored when hunt is turned off. The price table resets on stop (e.g. /trademaster stop); disabling the enchantment in the config mid-run pauses its hunt, re-enabling resumes it

trademaster.settings.grindstoneEnabled.c: When a grindstone position and a curse drop direction are both set, enchanted books are recycled at the grindstone instead of stored into chests (one at a time; cursed books go to bound chests first, then get dropped in the configured direction)
trademaster.settings.grindstoneOpenRetri: Max retries when the grindstone menu fails to open (laggy servers); each attempt waits up to 3 seconds before retrying, -1 retries forever

Direction used to drop cursed books, format: yaw, pitch. Yaw: -180 = north, -90 = east, 0 = south, 90 = west. Pitch: 0 = horizontal, positive = down, negative = up (max ±90). Required for grindstone mode; leave empty to fall back to chest deposit

trademaster.settings.nonBookDisposal.com: Cannot be ground means: cursed books (the grindstone keeps curses) and your custom goods. When every bound chest refuses them: stop and let you handle it, or drop them facing the configured drop direction. An ordinary enchanted book is only ever stored, never dropped; in grindstone mode the cursed books are handled by that path (chest, then drop), so this option only covers goods.
